context: FBS-240 needs exactly one Deploy target ADR (D2 skeleton:deployAdr; ADR-4160). rcf-lite is a command-line tool and MCP server that runs on the user's machine; nothing is hosted.
decision: rcf-lite is delivered as one npm package, rcf-lite, from packages/rcf-lite, published by .github/workflows/publish.yml when a tag rcf-lite-v<version> is pushed (pnpm publish --provenance --access public).
consequences: Users install it with npm or run it with npx; a release is a tag; there is no server, container or cloud target to provision.
title: Deploy target: the rcf-lite npm package, published from a release tag
